newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 450 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 450 bln won to banks.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Monday it has decided to supply 450 billion won to commercial banks through overnight repurchase agreements (Repos) to relieve a liquidity shortage in the money market.
"The central bank decided to supply 450 billion won through overnight repos since banks appeared 450 billion won short in their reserve requirements," a central bank official said.
A twice-a-month deadline for the won's reserve requirement with the central bank is due on Monday.
